newsitem.title: ISRAEL: ITT Sheraton in new Israeli hotel deal.
newsitem.headline: ITT Sheraton in new Israeli hotel deal.

text.p: ITT Sheraton Corp is negotiating a deal with Israeli entrepreneurs to manage a new hotel and apartment complex being built in Tel Aviv, the entrepreneurs said in a statement on Thursday.
As part of the deal ITT Sheraton would purchase one-third of the hotel and manage both the hotel and the apartments above the hotel, the statement said.
The estimated $100 million complex, called City Tower, is being built by enterepreneurs Izhak Tshuva, Yuli Ofer and Uri Dori, leading developers of real estate projects.

The statement said that the project, which would include a 200-room luxury business hotel, a congress centre and an apartment tower, would become Sheraton's first business hotel in Israel and would be called Sheraton City Tower.
ITT Sheraton Corp already manages a number of hotels in Israel. ITT Sheraton Corp is a unit of ITT Corp.
